title: Issue facts: what GitHub holds about one issue, read in one pass. No prose.

closed_first_at.description: When the issue was first closed in its present life, from its timeline: null while it has not been; while it is open, a time only where anyone but a person with write access reopened it last, which undid a close of this life. A merge that closes it closes it no earlier than the merge

author.description: Who opened the issue: its kind, name and write access, as any actor. Only a person who opened it accepts it by authorship; an App or the machine user, write access or none, does not

type.description: The issue's type as GitHub names it, or null where it has none. The Consumer entry may leave a type out

label_names.description: The name of every label the issue carries now, which the Consumer entry may leave out. The control labels are read from label_events alone

life_started_at.description: When the issue was opened, or last reopened by a person with write access: the start of its present life

reopened_last_by.description: Who reopened the issue last: a person with write access, anyone else, or nobody, as it was never reopened

reopened_last_at.description: When the issue was last reopened, by anyone: the start of the present life when a person with write access reopened it last, no earlier than that start when anyone else did, null when it never was

content_id.description: A hash of the issue's title and body, computed by the port. Comments are not content

content_changed_at.description: When the title or the body last changed, or the issue was opened

label_events.description: Every labeled and unlabeled event on the issue's timeline, with who added or removed the label and when, read with the timeline, so complete.timeline says whether they were read in full. The port gives them as the timeline lists them. The Kernel reads factory:hold, factory:hands-off and factory:admit as on a pull request, and factory:triage and factory:ready from their latest add, which any removal at or after it ends

linked.description: Each pull request that closes the issue, whoever opened it: the Kernel works out which are linked (I-39). complete.linked says whether every one was read

class.description: As the port works it out for a pull request

opened_at.description: When it opened. A linked one's opening moves the issue, as its close does

merged_at.description: When it merged; null unless it did

closed_at.description: When it closed, merged or not; null while it is open

label_events.description: The pull request's own label events, as on the issue. Its Hold, hands-off, and whether a person once admitted it, are read from them

closed_issue_at.description: When the issue's timeline records this pull request closing the issue, as the closer of a ClosedEvent: written at the merge, and changed by no later edit of its description (trials/P-33.json, trials/P-46.json). Null if it never closed the issue: one whose closing reference an edit added after its merge, or one that merged while the issue was closed

role_comments.description: For each Factory App that has commented, the time of its latest comment

last_writer_action_at.description: The last action on the issue by a person with write access

acts_since_writer.description: The Factory's acts on the issue since a person with write access last acted, read from the timeline (complete.timeline), as on a pull request: the act ceiling bounds them

branch_head.description: The head of the branch the next opening Run would push to, named from the issue's number and the count of pull requests the Factory has opened for it; null while that branch does not exist. The opening Run is admitted for it, and apply refuses once it has moved

timeline.description: Whether the timeline behind label_events was read in full

linked.description: Whether every pull request that closes the issue, and each one's label events, was read

runs.description: Whether the list of run records the pass read was whole

actor.description: Who acted, of what kind, and whether they have write access, as in a pull request's facts. A person is human with write access; nobody else is

time.description: UTC, to the second, each field in its range. That the day is one its month has, the Kernel checks
